funnel.notes: FS01-FS12 send 12 transfers to F01 on 2026-08-10/11; F01 forwards 90% to FO01 on 2026-08-12, more than 24 h after the last inflow (no dwell). 16 transfers, 3 active days, no history: no velocity, new-account or counterparty-profile signal. Outflows are 2.7x the account median.

cycle.notes: C01->C02 (08-17), C02->C03 (08-19), C03->C01 (08-21), time-ordered within 30 days. Each hop passes 70%, below FLOW.MIN_PASS_RATIO, so it is not layering.

outlier.notes: TX-OUT-1 (480,000 to its regular counterparty OR1) is the only amount with |Modified Z| > 3.5, globally and per channel. O01 starts in April (5 months < spike_months), so BEH-SPIKE has no baseline; OR1 is not a new counterparty.

velocity.notes: Regular since January (1-2 transfers per active day to VX01-VX12, stable monthly totals). 2026-08-12: 12 transfers in one day (velocity) which also lifts the August total far above the monthly baseline (spike). All counterparties already known.

offhours.notes: 5 transfers to HX1 on Saturdays or outside 08:00-18:00. Only 5 transfers, no history.

single_mule.notes: Opened 2026-08-01. 6 calm days (counts sent 1,2,1,2,1,2) then 12 in/12 out on 2026-08-11. 18 distinct sources MS01-MS18, out/in 0.92, inflows forwarded within 4 h, 21 transfers sent (39 in total) within 30 days of opening: 4 of 5 mule signals. No link to other mules.

mule_network.notes: N01-N04 opened 2026-07-15..22, same shape as M01 but only 3 sources each (NF1, NBk, NSk): dwell + new account + velocity = 3 signals. NF1 pays all four on 2026-08-03 (feeder), all four pay NC1 on 2026-08-05 (collector). Sinks NOk/NZk receive from one mule only.

new_large_counterparty.notes: 10 transfers a month to PR1-PR3 since January (median about 700). In August its only transfer is TX-NEWCP-1 to PX1 at 10x the median: new counterparty with large amount, and 100% new counterparties in a month with 7 months of history. August total equals the monthly baseline, so no BEH-SPIKE.

conventions.attribution: STAT-MAD, BEH-VELOCITY, BEH-SPIKE, TEMP-OFFHOURS, CPTY-PROFILE and CPTY-NEW-LARGE flag the sending account (from_acct).
conventions.baselines: BEH-VELOCITY needs >= velocity_days prior active days; BEH-SPIKE and CPTY-PROFILE need >= spike_months prior active months.
conventions.FLOW-LAYERING: every account on a qualifying path
conventions.NET-FUNNEL / MULE-DWELL: the account that receives and forwards
conventions.MULE-NEW-ACCT: same result whether transfers are counted on both sides or sent only, and for basis opened_at or first_seen
conventions.MULE-CROSS-TX: the collector and feeder accounts (no mule-to-mule transfer is planted)
